races.paceDynamic: Pioneer Pete will be the lone leader from the start, setting a comfortable tempo without early pressure from the 6 prominent runners (Double Tiger, Emerald Time, Chico Magnifica, Hashtag Queen, Collanisi, Asta La Vista) who will create a congested pack behind. The 7 hold-up horses including Our Guide, King Esoteric, and Prince Of Clova will need room turning for home, creating traffic issues when the prominent group starts to weaken 2-3 out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete jumps cleanly and maintains a steady gallop without interference
scenarios.body: The lone leader builds an unassailable advantage while the prominent pack gets in each other's way. Hold-up horses can't make up the ground despite late efforts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the 6 prominent runners go too fast chasing Pioneer Pete and fade badly
scenarios.body: Traffic chaos ensues 3 out as tired prominent horses block the hold-up brigade's path. Strong finishers like Our Guide profit from the carnage if they find daylight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and Pioneer Pete ties up approaching 2 out
scenarios.body: The prominent runners empty their tanks leaving the race to the late closers. Our Guide's strong finishing kick becomes decisive in a slowly-run finale.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos Special
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or mistakes completely reshape the race at the business end
scenarios.body: All tactical planning goes out the window as the race becomes a lottery. Any horse left standing with jumping ability can capitalize on others' misfortune.
